name: Can I keep part of the garage as parking after partial conversion?

mainEntity.name: Can I keep part of the garage as parking after partial conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, partial conversions are allowed with fire-rated separations (½" drywall min), no openings between spaces, and proper separation of conditioned vs unconditioned areas.
